posts.text: IMHO market is looking for an answer to what next ? They promised 500 Cr. by FY27 in their first concall held in Nov’23 (~5x from FY23 levels). They have beautifully delivered so far and seem on track to meet their target for FY27. The business is now in steady state, but there are no visible answers to what can sustain the growth rate of last 2 years for next 2-3 years. FIBA revenue will be icing but may not help to sustain the growth rate which came from the introduction of Air springs.
